title: Compositional synthetic controls vs the author's replication R (Pennsylvania AEPS)
reference_impl: csc_replication.R, provided by the paper's author (quadprog::solve.QP on the stacked ALR log-odds, Aitchison distance, placebo permutation), run live
notes: The script is the author's own, provided directly and not published as a package. It is unedited above the appended capture block; two additive changes: the input path comes from argv, and a machine-readable block prints the same quantities at ten decimals instead of the three the console tables round to.

It runs against basedata/pa_aeps_generation.csv, the panel mlsynth itself reads, so the comparison is like for like and the provenance records that file's checksum. The script derives its own donor pool -- structural zeros plus OH, WV, VT -- and on the pre-filtered panel that step finds nothing left to drop, giving the same 42 donors it derives from the full 51-state file.
The author's data_energy.csv and basedata/pa_aeps_generation.csv agree to 1e-5 relative (max 147 MWh on gas, 12 on renewables, out of millions); the two runs are compared in the case docstring.
